location: Gloas and Fulu networking: data column request and response

en.title: Gloas networking: the data column request protocols are not updated for the new data column sidecar
en.summary: Gloas removes the signed block header, the KZG commitments and the inclusion proof from DataColumnSidecar and adds the slot and the beacon block root. The Gloas request and response section updates the block request protocols with a Gloas row, but says nothing about DataColumnSidecarsByRange and DataColumnSidecarsByRoot, which stay as defined in Fulu. Their context epoch is read from the signed block header, their type table maps every epoch from the Fulu fork on to the Fulu sidecar, and the reader is told to check the inclusion proof, which a Gloas sidecar does not have.
en.impact: For a response that carries a Gloas sidecar the text gives no context epoch, no type and no applicable check, so each client has to choose them on its own.
en.correction: Add Gloas sections for both protocols: the context epoch from the slot of the sidecar, a type table with a Gloas row, and checks that take the KZG commitments from the bid of the block named by the beacon block root, with no inclusion proof.
